renderEquality.boundary: Immutable baseline physical-pages vs current shared layout with actual six-file replay; all complete face hashes and canonical location mappings match per same preference. First four files used Playwright payload interception; remaining two use cookie-protected loopback streaming after target-closed failure.

readerEntry.boundary: Serial actual admin/live configured Jellyfin HTTP. Immutable main 463fa8ae physical-reader vs current server delivery, same Three.js host/cover entry. One warm-up pair plus three alternating timed pairs. Close releases last bytes; server retains exact-version manifest after first round. Excludes route hydration, includes session POST/download/index/render/entrance. Not whole-app production p95. No page turns.

normalBrowser.boundary: Actual normal-dev admin and original comic, genuine HTTP, desktop/mobile Chromium. Ephemeral admin login; no page turns or setting mutations. Browser plugin not available; existing Playwright fallback.
